context: Hello, I am here to help you looking for a movie trailer
Cool, thank you. I tend to like horror movies, know of any?
Have you heard of 'the boy 2'
Yes, i've seen the first one! I've seen one trailer for it already on tv but not any other.
Oh what did you like about it? I think you will like this one if you liked the last.
I liked how the story unfolded and finding out what was happening. I enjoyed the suspense. Is this from the same director?
yes William Brent Bell was the director from the first as well.
Cool, i'll check some of the other trailers for it. Thank you.
No problem!
Do you know of any other good upcoming horror movies?
how about 'scary movie'
Are they remaking it or making a new one?
I think they're done making them
Oh, okay. I think i've seen all of them already, can you recommend me a different one?
how about doctor sleep?
I don't know anything about it. What's it about?

its like a sequel years following the events of the shining, now-adult Dan Torrance meets a young girl with powers similar to his and he tries to protect her from a cult that preys on children with powers to remain immortal.
Oh, cool. I didn't know anything about it, that's good to know. I'll certainly check it out now thanks!
Good glad you like the recommendation.
Thanks again
you're welcome, enjoy your movie friend.

context.content: Hi there! What genre of movies do you usually enjoy?
Hey there! I'm a big fan of horror movies. Scary stuff keeps me on my toes!
That's great! Have you seen "Tales of Halloween" (2015)? It's a collection of short horror stories that might appeal to you.
"Tales of Halloween" sounds intriguing. Can you tell me more about it? Like, what kind of stories are included and how scary is it?

"Tales of Halloween" features various spooky tales like "The Black Cat," "The Monkey's Paw," and "The Signalman." It's pretty intense with some gory scenes, but also has moments of suspense and psychological horror.
Sounds like it could be right up my alley! I love a good scare with some suspense. [END]
